name: obsidian-open-bible
description: Offline-first Bible reader and study companion for Obsidian.

scripts.build:deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:gh: npm run build && gh release create $(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") --title=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") --draft main.js manifest.json styles.css

author: Open Mission
